subject: design/citation-resolution
statement: resolution is **present-or-dangling**, and superseded counts as present. A unit ID that appears anywhere in its projection — a live row *or* a "Superseded & retired" row — resolves; supersede is not retire, and a citation to a superseded unit is legitimate (the stale-cite signal). Only a target **absent entirely** — a typo, a never-existed ID, a deleted record — is dangling and fatal.
